name: How do low threshold showers prevent water from leaking onto the bathroom floor?

mainEntity.name: How do low threshold showers prevent water from leaking onto the bathroom floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water containment relies on proper floor slope, drain placement, and splash guards. Low threshold bases feature an inward-sloping perimeter that directs runoff toward the drain rather than across the bathroom floor. Homeowners can pair the shallow curb with a heavy-duty, weighted shower curtain, a sliding bypass door, or a custom glass partition. Ensuring the shower valve and spray head are angled away from the opening also plays a vital role in keeping bathroom floors dry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water is contained by an inward-sloping floor base, proper showerhead placement, and enclosures like glass panels or weighted curtains.
